steps.text: If needed, connect the power supply to TouchLinc and plug it into an outlet.
Press and hold the Power button on the left edge until TouchLinc begins to boot up.
steps.expect: TouchLinc boots up and a network setup dialog box opens

steps.text: Download and install the latest OS firmware and native app to TouchLinc.

notes: Typical battery life is 3 to 4 hours; keep the charger plugged in when TouchLinc is not in use.
Settings changes are lost when TouchLinc is powered off, and only files in the My Computer > NAND folder are kept.

verification.note: Read from the TouchLinc 2448 manual; the product list gives the 2448A7T the name TouchLinc.
